title: Trump's Team Has More Super-Rich People Than the Last Three Presidents Combined!
summary:
Have you ever wondered how much money the people running the country have? A new report has a surprising answer about President Trump's team. It turns out there are more super-rich people in his administration than in the last three presidents' teams combined!

The report comes from a group called Public Citizen, which watches out for regular people. They found that 57 people working for Trump are worth at least $100 million each. That's a LOT of money—like having 100 million one-dollar bills. To compare, President George W. Bush's team had 5 people that rich, President Obama's had 3, and President Biden's had 5. So Trump's 57 is more than four times all of those added together!

Who are these super-rich officials? Eight of the 23 people in Trump's Cabinet are worth over $100 million. Treasury Secretary Howard Lutnick and Education Secretary Linda McMahon are both billionaires—that means they have over a billion dollars! Deputy Defense Secretary Stephen Feinberg and Small Business Administrator Kelly Loeffler are also billionaires.

Trump himself is a billionaire too, worth over $6 billion. And his friend Elon Musk, the world's richest person, is worth about $860 billion—but he's not counted in the report because he's not an official government employee.

Why does this matter? The people at Public Citizen say when the government is full of ultra-rich people, it can lead to problems. "When the people holding the reins of government are drawn overwhelmingly from the ranks of the ultra-rich, it leads to misplaced incentives and corruption," said Lisa Gilbert, one of the group's leaders. In other words, they might make decisions that help rich people instead of everyone else.

Trump says he likes appointing rich people because they're smart and successful. "They have great competence, those people," he said. But not everyone agrees. Last month, only 32% of Americans approved of how Trump is handling the economy—down from 40% when he started. With an election coming up in November, that could be a problem for his party.
why_it_matters: If leaders are super rich, their choices could affect things like your family's money, jobs, and schools.
